title: On Sárközy-Sós Theorem related to representation functions
summary: Let $\mathbb{N}_0$ be the set of all nonnegative integers. For a nonempty set $\mathcal{A}\subseteq \mathbb{N}_0$ and integers $n,h\ge 2$, let $r_{h}(\mathcal{A},n)$ be the number of representations of $n$ as $a_1+\cdots+a_h$, where $a_1\le \cdots\le a_h$ and $a_i\in \mathcal{A}$ for $i=1,\cdots,h$.
